notes.title: Spanish and Chinese localization, keyboard UI navigation and dynamic lighting!
notes.content:
Hellbreachers are now available on spanish and chinese languages.
The game is translated entirely including UI subtitles and character parameters.

Now you are able to navigate through user interface with only a keyboard. 
Switch character specialisations, choose settings and scroll through levels without mouse.

New dynamic lighting system will involve you in the game more.
 It is unique for every level and every location, making Hellbreachers look fresh and constantly changing to different shadow zones.

notes.title: Hellbreachers now available on all consoles!
notes.content:
Hellbreachers now available on PS4, PS5, Nintendo Switch, Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S!
Hellbreachers got published by Eastasiasoft on all consoles.

Check out the game here https://www.eastasiasoft.com/games/Hellbreachers
